predictions.text: I predict that the film Focker-in-Law will be released in all other countries by Paramount Pictures on November 25, 2026.
I predict that the detonation of Lead(II) azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant will occur as planned.
I predict that the Shenzhou 24 mission will successfully launch and dock as planned.

I predict that Ukraine launches additional drone attacks on Russian targets, potentially targeting critical infrastructure in Lublin Voivodeship or naval vessels in the Gulf of Finland, with at least one strike on a Russian cargo vessel by the end of Wednesday, 2 December 2026.
I predict that the Colombian conflict will continue with at least one more attack in a rural area of Colombia, causing injuries to at least 21 people.
I predict that at least 30 people are injured and 12 shops are damaged in the aftermath of the Bangladesh July Uprising conflict by the end of Wednesday, 2 December 2026.
I predict that a prominent military unit will arrest at least five additional suspected criminals in a city in Mexico and another urban area in the country by the end of Wednesday, 2 December 2026.
I predict that a 58-year-old student will die during a hunger strike at Sapienza University in Rome, Italy, while the government responds with arrests in multiple cities across the country.
I predict that a prominent politician does not enter Spain and faces no charges by the end of Wednesday, 2 December 2026.
I predict that the bomb threat wave will spread to at least two more schools in Germany by the end of Wednesday, 2 December 2026.
